problem:
Suppose we would like to find the maximum of the function $f(x,y,z)={x}^{2}y+{z}^{2}$ on the intersection of the surfaces $y-{x}^{2}=1$ and ${x}^{2}+2{y}^{2}+{z}^{2}=4$ using the method of Lagrange multipliers. Then, the corresponding Lagrange multipliers $\lambda $ and $\mu $ satisfy the following system:

$$
{\begin{aligned}⟨\,,\,{x}^{2},\,2z⟩=\lambda ⟨\,,\,1,\,0⟩+\mu ⟨2x,\,,\,2z⟩ \\ y-{x}^{2}=1 \\ {x}^{2}+2{y}^{2}+{z}^{2}=4\end{aligned}
$$

From left to right, what are the missing parts of the expressions?
